ceiling_rationale: Interactive liveness and device-bound credential verification are implemented, so the derivation computes levels 2 and 3 and withholds them until a confirmed-human false-positive and abandonment interval exists per level. Issuer credentials and uniqueness have no verifier at all.

profiles.request: one action on the transaction surface; validity at most five minutes
profiles.content: one message, bound to a sender-computed content commitment; validity at most seven days, issued_at is the evidence age at send
profiles.channel: one interval of one call channel; validity at most two minutes, re-issued every interval

scenarios.description: A level 1 assertion with verified interaction evidence is accepted for its own audience inside its validity window.
A level 0 assertion carries no human evidence and is still structurally valid.
Level 2 is computed by the derivation but withheld until measured; a verifier refuses it because no measurement exists yet.
Level 3 is computed by the derivation but withheld until measured; a verifier refuses it because no measurement exists yet.
Level 5 claims issuer-asserted uniqueness that nothing here verifies.
A level 1 assertion without the behavioral evidence class is malformed.
Issuer-scope uniqueness without the issuer evidence class is malformed.
An assertion minted for another relying service does not verify here.
Raising the level after signing breaks the signature.
A correctly shaped assertion signed by another key is rejected.
A signature produced under the signed local artifact domain must not verify as an assertion.
The document is closed; an added field is rejected rather than ignored.
An assertion evaluated after its expiry fails closed.
An assertion issued beyond the tolerated clock skew is rejected.
A content-profile assertion bound to a sender-computed content commitment verifies for its recipient scope.
A channel-profile assertion bound to a channel commitment and an interval verifies for the other participant.
A content assertion is still verifiable days after it was minted: on the message surface validity is long and issued_at carries the evidence age.
A request assertion evaluated days later has expired: the transaction surface keeps a validity of minutes.
A content assertion whose validity exceeds seven days is malformed; a signer that wrote it is not this implementation.
A channel assertion whose validity exceeds two minutes defeats re-attestation and is malformed.
A request binding that also carries a content commitment could be read under the wrong profile and is refused.
A profile outside the closed vocabulary is refused rather than treated as a request.
Changing the content commitment after signing breaks the signature: the assertion is bound to what was sent.
